title: Weekend Plans
subtitle: Talking about free-time activities — for English learners

sentences.en: What are you doing this weekend?
sentences.target: What are you doing this weekend?

sentences.en: I'm not sure yet. Maybe I'll go to the park.
sentences.target: I'm not sure yet. Maybe I'll go to the park.

sentences.en: Do you want to come to the movies with us on Saturday?
sentences.target: Do you want to come to the movies with us on Saturday?

sentences.en: That sounds great. What movie are you going to see?
sentences.target: That sounds great. What movie are you going to see?

sentences.en: We were thinking of the new comedy that just came out.
sentences.target: We were thinking of the new comedy that just came out.

sentences.en: What time should we meet, and where?
sentences.target: What time should we meet, and where?

sentences.en: Let's meet at six o'clock in front of the cinema.
sentences.target: Let's meet at six o'clock in front of the cinema.

sentences.en: Should we have dinner before or after the movie?
sentences.target: Should we have dinner before or after the movie?

sentences.en: After is better. There's a pizza place right next door.
sentences.target: After is better. There's a pizza place right next door.

sentences.en: Perfect. I'll see you on Saturday at six.
sentences.target: Perfect. I'll see you on Saturday at six.
